aviation_incidents.headline: 法國軍用飛機南錫附近墜毀 機型尚未確認
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架法國軍用飛機於2026年10月20日晚在法國東北部南錫附近墜毀。Pont-à-Mousson市長Henry Lemoine表示，飛機約於當地時間23時35分在Rogéville、Domèvre-en-Haye與Tremblecourt之間墜毀。事件引發夜間搜索行動。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: French military aircraft crashes near Nancy; type not officially confirmed
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A French military aircraft crashed near Nancy in northeastern France late on October 20, 2026. Henry Lemoine, mayor of Pont-à-Mousson, said the aircraft went down at approximately 23:35 local time in an area between Rogéville, Domèvre-en-Haye and Tremblecourt. The crash prompted a major overnight search operation.

aviation_incidents.summary: LATAM Airlines一架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320），註冊編號CC-BFS，於2026年10月19日在祕魯利馬的Jorge Chávez International Airport（LIM）滑行前往跑道時，發動機起火，機上人員隨後撤離。報導指出，飛機當時準備執行LA 2302航班，目的地為Piura（PIU）；左側CFM56發動機起火，原因尚待查明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: LATAM Airlines A320 evacuated after engine fire at Lima airport
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A LATAM Airlines Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), registration CC-BFS, was evacuated after an engine fire while on the tarmac at Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM) in Lima, Peru, on October 19, 2026. The aircraft was taxiing toward the runway as it prepared to operate flight LA 2302 to Piura (PIU). The report said the fire began in the port-side CFM56 engine; its cause has not been established.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空規劃於2027年開航臺北桃園國際機場（TPE）經澳洲雪梨機場（SYD）至紐西蘭奧克蘭機場（AKL）的航線，拓展大洋洲航網。雪梨機場已於2026年6月2日公告，雪梨將成為星宇在澳洲的首個航點，航班並將延伸至奧克蘭。

taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部長顧立雄表示，臺中機場的無人機防禦系統（UDS）已完成驗收，預計10月底以前可發揮相關功能。顧立雄說，待複驗完成、空軍各基地陸續建置完畢後，UDS可用於幹擾第一、二型無人機。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taichung Airport Drone Defense System Accepted, Expected to Function by Month-End
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: CNA reported that Defense Minister 顧立雄 said the drone defense system (UDS) at Taichung Airport has completed acceptance. He said it should be able to perform its functions before the end of October. 顧立雄 also said configuration changes to include the 5.17 GHz band in the system's jamming frequencies began this year.

taiwan_aviation.summary_en: A Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft has deployed to Japan to take part in Exercise Keen Sword, AeroTime reports. The exercise is running from October 19 to 29, 2026, and involves around 260 aircraft.

He said the relocation concerns Taipei and Taiwan’s development over the coming decades, and called for efforts to address obstacles and pursue the goal.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 松山機場遷移構想待審慎評估 空勤基地尚無替代方案
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安宣佈規劃遷移松山機場，打造臺北人工智慧（AI）園區。內政部長劉世芳表示，空勤總隊松山基地目前沒有替代方案。她指出，空勤總隊操作直升機需要一定場地，才能支援救災、救難及醫療後送；遷移要選擇何處，須審慎評估。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Songshan Airport relocation plan draws scrutiny as air-service base lacks an alternative
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 announced plans to relocate Songshan Airport and develop a Taipei artificial-intelligence (AI) park. Interior Minister 劉世芳 said the Airborne Service Corps’ Songshan base currently has no alternative. She said helicopter operations need suitable space to support rescue work and medical evacuation, and that any relocation destination requires careful assessment.

international_aviation.headline_en: Eurocontrol delivers iNM Wave 2.5.1, expanding eEAD AIP production

The release expands the iNM Digital Platform to include aeronautical information publication (AIP) production, as part of a gradual migration from the European AIS Database (EAD) to the enhanced eEAD.

international_aviation.headline: WCC Aviation Holdings同意收購PhilJets Aero Services三成股權
international_aviation.summary: WCC Aviation Holdings表示，已同意收購PhilJets Aero Services 30%股權。PhilJets Aero Services位於馬尼拉，提供商務噴射機與直升機服務。WCC Aviation Holdings於2026年10月20日宣佈這項協議；協議於10月15日由該公司總裁Dr. Raymond Patrick V. Guico與PhilJets董事長Thierry Tea簽署。
international_aviation.headline_en: WCC Aviation Holdings agrees to acquire 30% stake in PhilJets Aero Services
international_aviation.summary_en: WCC Aviation Holdings said on October 20, 2026, that it had agreed to acquire a 30% stake in PhilJets Aero Services, a Manila-based provider of business jet and helicopter services. The agreement was signed on October 15 by WCC Aviation Holdings President Dr. Raymond Patrick V. Guico and PhilJets Chairman Thierry Tea.

international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing launches Dataliner AI data platform for airline fleet insights
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing unveiled Dataliner on October 20, 2026, in conjunction with technology firm Microsoft. Boeing describes it as an AI-powered aircraft data platform intended to give airlines and operators deeper insight into their fleets. The platform is designed to connect fragmented data into fleet-wide intelligence that supports maintenance and operational decisions.

international_aviation.headline_en: Hawaiian Airlines holds disability practice flight in Honolulu
international_aviation.summary_en: Hawaiian Airlines said it welcomed 258 travelers with disabilities and their families aboard an Airbus A330 in Honolulu on October 18, 2026. The event took place at Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL). The airline described it as the largest disability practice flight ever held, and said it was the carrier’s first practice flight in Honolulu since 2016.
